title: South Korea Dispatches 44-Member Disaster Relief Team to Nepal After Floods
detail: South Korea is sending a 44-member disaster relief team to Nepal to assist with flood response, signaling continued regional humanitarian engagement in South Asia.

title: Hyundai Motor's South Korean Union Approves New Wage Deal
detail: Hyundai Motor's South Korean union approved a new wage deal, resolving a key labor dispute at the country's largest automaker and averting potential industrial action.
